world.headline:
A new world
A hunter’s calling
world.description: Beyond the familiar lies a living world of ancient forests, untamed monsters, and a craft worth mastering. Your expedition starts here.

iceborne.headline:

Beyond your limits
iceborne.description: The Hinterlands call. Master new moves, uncover the Guiding Lands, and prepare for the most demanding hunts of your expedition.
